method: Deterministic HTTP calls against the live endpoint; no model. Behaviour tests check that a missing public condition is asked for (2026 clients) or blocked (2025 clients) and never guessed, that borrower attributes are refused, that receipts verify and tampering is detected, and that the sentence gate grades the published vectors.

results.name: server/discover answers with protocol versions, capabilities and task table
tools/list is deterministic across two calls
2026 client, missing term and date -> input_required with exactly those fields
2026 client, only date missing -> input_required for the date alone, no number
retry with inputResponses resolves the cell (15 bps) and returns complete
all conditions present -> complete, correct cell for three known inputs
case date before the rule's effective date -> block RULE_NOT_IN_FORCE, no number
borrower attributes (income, credit score) are refused, not used
2025 client (no elicitation capability), missing fields -> block CONDITION_MISSING, no number
2025 initialize handshake still works and returns a session
rule receipt from test 06 verifies as current; a tampered value does not
sentence gate: stale value + second-person prediction -> block with both codes
resolver: frc:rule id redirects to the rule file
cite card: /cite/<claim-id> returns a receipted sentence whose receipt verifies as current
receipt forgery: a real claim id with a hash never issued is 'unrecognized' with no correction; an unknown id is refused cleanly
results.evidence: forged=unrecognized correction=false; pre-correction=stale correction=true; unknown id=200 unknown claim id
